root: NC_ENRICHMENT_ROOT; otherwise NC_CONFIG_ROOT/enrichment; config defaults to ~/.config/netcap (no-home fallback /usr/local/etc/netcap)
runtime_admission: owned Software/HTTP hooks call the separate enrichment offline resolver and load its verified active version directory; an unavailable/unverified snapshot uses two first-party builtins, not a loose unsigned catalogue
runtime_snapshot: verified catalogue bytes are read once at capture initialization; Go HTTP PostInit refreshes the capture snapshot and Rust initialize_webtech publishes an Arc snapshot retained by each new HTTP parser; no per-packet disk verification
go_retained_software: at most 4096 webtech claims per software-cache lifetime; excess counted as software-record-limit; ResetCaches resets admission
core_database_policy: separate; no core source-policy or allowlist changes
defaults: two first-party builtins; four descriptors only when a valid optional catalogue is present
admission: at most four unique reviewed fixed descriptors; unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys, changed semantics and trailing JSON rejected
scope: paired observed GET response, status 200; origin authority plus flow and response-start timestamp; no host/IP inventory conclusion
html_subset: UTF-8; ASCII-case-insensitive tag and attribute names; quoted or unquoted attributes; comments and raw-text excluded; stop at first template or overlong/unfinished tag; no entity decoding or DOM recovery
token: case-sensitive exact product followed by ASCII space or end; numeric dotted version token only, maximum 32 bytes; Drupal major only; Joomla no version; absent versions emit precision none
interpretation: Empty matches never establish technology absence, including on a complete prefix. Advertisements may be spoofed.
privacy: No cookie input; raw body, generator header value and URL query not copied into Software. Existing HTTP audit privacy settings remain separate.

software_fields.Notes: rule; precision; scope=origin-transaction; authority; transaction timestamp

forbidden: CVE or exploit lookup on webtech advertisements
